title: PalSchema item-loader entry (UPalStaticItemData)
description: One entry of a PalSchema items-folder mod file ({ "<ItemId>": { ...these fields } }; a null value deletes the item). The item loader matches keys against UPalStaticItemDataBase and its Armor/Weapon/Consume subclasses (GetPropertyByNameInChain) plus its own keys (Type, Name, Description, Recipe, SortID, bLegalInGame); anything else is ignored, with an in-game warning since PalSchema 0.6.3 (Okaetsu/PalSchema#138). Fields are optional (partial patches edit existing items; only NEW items need Type). Palworld 1.0, class members verified against localcc/PalworldModdingKit@62fad41. Value constraints ported from PalSchema's own items.schema.json (tag 0.6.5, https://github.com/Okaetsu/PalSchema/pull/145): per-Type scoping is keyed on Type via if/then (upstream's anyOf branches do not scope), the required list is gated on the presence of Type so partial patches of existing items stay valid, float-literal rules are checked on raw text by palschema-validate, and upstream's AttackPower is a typo for AttackValue (not added).
$comment: palschema-hub | loader=items | rowStruct=UPalStaticItemDataBase(+Armor/Weapon/Consume) | palworldVersion=1.0 | fields=38 | source=sdk-headers+loader-overlay | sdk=localcc/PalworldModdingKit@62fad41 | upstreamConstraints=0.6.5@b41a965 (https://github.com/Okaetsu/PalSchema/pull/145; scoping is if/then keyed on Type because upstream's anyOf branches do not scope; upstream's AttackPower is a typo for AttackValue and is not added) | floatLiteral=Weight,CorruptionFactor,Durability,SneakAttackRate,WorkAmount | stackSoftCap=MaxStackCount:9999 | loaderKeys=Type,Name,Description,Recipe,SortID,bLegalInGame

ID.description: FName — set from the mod key when adding, ignored when editing. Class property (UPalStaticItemDataBase).

IconTexture.description: Asset/class reference (TSoftObjectPtr<UTexture2D>) — string asset path or exported object form — Class property (UPalStaticItemDataBase). Upstream (items.schema.json@0.6.5): A /Game path must repeat the asset name after the dot (/Game/.../T_icon_X.T_icon_X — a mismatch like T_icon_A.T_icon_B is a typo the game resolves to nothing), or use $resource/<ModName>/<Image> for an imported image.

anyOf.description: Exported-object form of the soft pointer (TSoftObjectPtr<UTexture2D>).
Game asset path; the asset name must repeat after the dot, e.g. /Game/Others/InventoryItemIcon/Texture/T_itemicon_Food_Berries.T_itemicon_Food_Berries
Image imported via PalSchema's resource loader, e.g. $resource/YourModName/NameOfYourImageWithoutExtension (works since PalSchema 0.5.0).

Rank.description: IntProperty — Class property (UPalStaticItemDataBase). Upstream (items.schema.json@0.6.5): Minimum 0 (crafting-station tier; only relevant for crafting).

Rarity.description: IntProperty — Class property (UPalStaticItemDataBase). Upstream (items.schema.json@0.6.5): 0..4 = Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary.

Price.description: IntProperty — Class property (UPalStaticItemDataBase). Upstream (items.schema.json@0.6.5): Minimum 0; the in-game value is this divided by 10.

MaxStackCount.description: IntProperty — Class property (UPalStaticItemDataBase). Upstream (items.schema.json@0.6.5): Minimum 1. Above 9999 the game duplicates items when moving stacks (upstream documents this in prose, so the validator warns rather than errors — see softCaps).
